description: This file defines a Java class `Transistor` that extends `GraphStage` from Akka Streams API, implementing a flow component with specified input and output ports. It models a transistor-like flow regulator using inlets for collector and base, and an outlet for emitter, controlling element flow with credit management logic. The class includes logic for handling backpressure and regulating flow based on credits and demand, with detailed internal methods for managing pull and push operations within Akka's stream stage lifecycle.

classes.name: Transistor
classes.description: A final generic class extending `GraphStage`, modeling a transistor-like flow controller with internal logic embodied in `TransistorLogic`.

classes.name: TransistorLogic
classes.description: An inner class extending `GraphStageLogicWithLogging` that manages the actual event handling, flow control, and state management for the `Transistor` stage.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of `Transistor` with specified element type.

methods.name: shape
methods.description: Returns the shape of the graph stage, a `FanInShape2` with collector, base, and emitter ports.

methods.name: createLogic
methods.description: Creates the logic for the stage, returning an instance of `TransistorLogic`.

methods.name: preStart
methods.description: Overrides the preStart method to initiate pulling from the base inlet when the stage starts.
